name: DuckTales Game Boy ROM decompilation with PHP

mentions.name: DuckTales Game Boy ROM decompilation with PHP
mentions.description: An experiment decompiling the DuckTales Game Boy ROM using PHP, with the follow-up goal of seeing whether PHP can be used to create a Game Boy game, undertaken purely to see if it can be done.
mentions.source_excerpt: Secondarily, decompiling the DuckTails Gameboy ROM with PHP... then seeing about using PHP to create a GameBoy game. For no reason than to see if it can be done.
